title: Nature and Art
summary: "Nature and Art" by Mrs. Inchbald is a novel published in 1796. This satirical fable follows two generations of the Norwynne family, tracing how education, privilege, and social conventions shape human behavior. Two brothers take vastly different paths—one through music, one through the church—leading to estrangement and reconciliation. Their sons, bearing the same names, inherit contrasting upbringings that expose the corrupting effects of England's social system.
